title: Photo Release Information Sheet
subtitle: Capture capture type, event setting, audience, and channel; confirm attribution and withdrawal route.
description: Photo Release records capture type, event setting, audience, channel, attribution, and withdrawal route. Photo Release evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this photo release controlled information handoff when staff must document capture type and event setting. Reconcile audience, channel, attribution, and withdrawal route before the photo release handoff. Use the capture plan, shot list, subject or roster match, approved channel list, production exclusion list, published-asset reference, and withdrawal request log. Ask the assigned photo release reviewer to confirm capture type against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Photo Release audience details review
sections.guidance: Separate still image, video, audio, name use, event setting, audience, channel, editing, attribution, duration, declined uses, and withdrawal route. Record the photo release decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

sections.title: Photo Release current instructions
sections.guidance: List current instructions, their source, and any operating limit.
